name: Image Hover Effects
description: Extends the core Image and Responsive Image field formatters with a selectable CSS hover effect and an optional overlay caption (token-aware) on linked images.

suggests.drupal/token: Enables a token-tree browser under the Hover text setting so entity tokens (e.g. [node:title]) can be inserted into the overlay caption.

provides_plugin_types: Field formatter: image_hover_effects_image (Image with hover effect) — extends core image formatter
Field formatter: image_hover_effects_responsive_image (Responsive image with hover effect) — extends core responsive_image formatter
project_description:
A community contribution of DXPR and our Drupal Layout Builder for Marketers.

Field Formatter that adds a hover effect to a linked image.

This module integrates with Drupal core Fields API as well as the Views API.

The hover effect option is added to the field formatter of the core Image field (and the Responsive Image field). Since it only makes sense to have a hover effect on an image that is a link, the styling depends on a link being wrapped around the image, so the effect activates only when the formatter's own Link image to setting points at the content or file. An optional Hover text overlay can be shown on hover, and supports tokens for pulling in entity data.
